evals.prompt: Using the provided newproj skill, scaffold an existing nonempty project in the run's outputs/project directory. First create these root files with simple distinct contents: analysis.py, test_analysis.py, prices.csv, chart.png, memo.pdf, deck.pptx, notes.txt, and pyproject.toml. Then run the skill initializer with --force and save its output to outputs/run.log.
evals.expected_output: Recognized scripts, tests, data, figures, reports, and slides move into their standard folders with contents preserved; unrecognized root files stay in place.
expectations: analysis.py moves from the project root to src/analysis.py with its content preserved
test_analysis.py moves from the project root to tests/test_analysis.py with its content preserved
prices.csv, chart.png, memo.pdf, and deck.pptx move respectively to data/raw, output/figures, report, and slides with contents preserved
notes.txt and pyproject.toml remain unchanged in the project root
The standard scaffold and AGENTS.md are created without overwriting existing work
